_comment: Labelled eval cases. sources are matched on basename so the same case works
whether the index was built on the host or inside the container.
must_retrieve: the router is expected to offer answer_docs for this question.
must_abstain: answer_docs is expected to say it does not know.
must_cite: the answer must carry [n] citations that resolve to sources.
model_ok: whether the main model would call answer_docs when the router said yes.
it is scored separately because routing accuracy read 1.00 while the agent was
completely broken - the 7B answered "no tool" instead of searching. run_turn now
forces the call, so this column measures what the prompt alone would have done.

cases.query: how long is the hotel booked for?
which place are we travelling to?
what is the capital of France?
what did the lease say about the termination clause?
Where are we going in November?
when are we going to Hampi?

_holdout_comment: Written after the router prompt was last tuned, and never used to change it.
This is the honest number. `cases` above is a tuning set, so its score is
optimistic. Re-tune against cases, then read holdout.

holdout.query: when did I book that hotel?
remind me what we decided about the venue
what's my email address on file?
how do I reverse a list in python?
